profile.headline: Software Engineering Consultant | Senior Lead Software Engineer | Fractional Technical Lead | Enterprise Software | C#/.NET | Remote (US)
profile.summary:
Senior Lead Software Engineer specializing in cloud platforms, distributed systems, data pipelines, enterprise software, and full-stack application development.  Strong in C#/.NET and SQL with working proficiency in TypeScript and Python. Primarily AWS-focused, with Azure DevOps experience and familiarity with GCP. Bachelor's degree in Computer Information Systems. 

SKILLS 

Leadership & Delivery
 • Technical leadership, end-to-end delivery ownership, mentoring, coaching, one-on-ones, code reviews, release readiness
 • Engineering standards, application modernization, technical debt remediation, continuous improvement
 • Cross-functional collaboration; translating business needs into scalable technical solutions
 • Incident response, root-cause analysis, risk identification
 • Technical documentation, knowledge sharing, onboarding materials
 • Agile (Scrum, Kanban), sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization

 Data & Cloud
 • AWS (EKS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, CloudWatch, IAM, DMS)
 • Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
 • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
 • Azure DevOps, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, YAML-based build and deployment automation 
 • Observability: logging, monitoring, alerting 
 • SQL Server, PostgreSQL; database design, indexing, query optimization
 • Data pipelines, ETL processes, metadata management, data governance
 
Software Development
 • C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, Python 
 • Angular, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Blazor, HTML5, CSS
 • REST API design and implementation (OpenAPI, Swagger); API integration; GraphQL familiarity 
 • System architecture, POC development, object-oriented design, dependency injection, design patterns
 • Multi-threaded programming, concurrency, and performance optimization
 • Authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT, Okta, IAM); testing (xUnit, Moq) 
 • Static Application Security Testing (SAST): Fortify Static Code Analyzer (SCA), SonarQube 
 • AI-assisted and agentic software development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot)

 PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
 • SDD Conf - Software Design & Development Conference, London, UK (2023) : 3-day conference on software development and architecture
 • ArchConf - Software Architecture Conference, Chicago, IL (2022) :  3-day conference on software architecture, code refactoring, microservices, DDD, EKS 
 • Fundamentals of Software Architecture - Mark Richards, Denver, CO (2019): 3-day course covering software architecture principles and soft skills for architects

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer & Consultant
positions.description:
Helping businesses reduce manual work and run more smoothly through automation, custom software, and AI.

Work includes custom application development, data and system integrations, cloud systems, and legacy modernization. I also identify where AI can realistically add value to business workflows, then help put it in place.

For businesses that need experienced technical guidance without a full-time hire, I work as a fractional technical lead. I help set software priorities, guide developers, review vendor work, and make informed technology decisions.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer - Data Management
positions.description:
• Technical Lead for enterprise data management initiatives, driving solution architecture and design, coordinating delivery across distributed engineering, Product, and QA teams, mentoring engineers, leading code reviews, and reducing technical debt
• Designed and implemented a C#/.NET REST API metadata integration platform on Amazon EKS that extracted metadata from distributed systems, including Google BigQuery, validated, enriched, and transformed it, and published it to Collibra via REST APIs; automated execution with Kubernetes YAML CronJobs
• Improved the reliability, observability, and execution time of a Python-based event-driven AWS Lambda pipeline that transformed reference data and schema files stored in Amazon S3 into Parquet, enriched and translated the data, and generated JSON-LD and RDF/Turtle artifacts served through Amazon CloudFront, integrating with an Amazon SQS-based cache invalidation workflow; implemented CloudWatch monitoring and alerts to detect timeouts and errors
• Managed AWS infrastructure using Terraform, enabling repeatable and secure Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments across environments, reducing operational risk
• Accelerated onboarding for engineers joining new and transferred projects by walking them through system architecture, environment setup, and tooling configuration to minimize time-to-productivity
• Owned production deployments, resolved release-blocking issues, and performed root-cause analysis for production incidents
• Remediated vulnerabilities flagged by Fortify SCA and SonarQube during automated Static Application Security Testing (SAST) in CI/CD pipelines
• Contributed to React/TypeScript frontend when needed to ensure timely feature delivery

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer - Data Management
positions.description:
• Owned solution design and end-to-end development of applications deployed on Amazon EKS, from concept through production, while mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and promoting engineering best practices
• Designed and built a metadata management web application using C#/.NET, Entity Framework, and Blazor that extracted schema metadata from SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL and transformed it into a common metadata model, enabling users to add business metadata before publishing it to an internal data catalog, significantly reducing manual effort
• Modernized, decoupled, and optimized a multithreaded C#/.NET backend for high-volume data refresh across SQL Server and PostgreSQL, reducing processing time from 24 hours to 8 hours; integrated AWS Database Migration Service via .NET SDK
• Built a Java proof of concept that published metadata to Collibra, an enterprise data governance platform, via its APIs, implemented BPMN workflow automation in Groovy, and presented the solution to business stakeholders 
• Optimized T-SQL queries and stored procedures and implemented indexes to improve application performance
• Authored technical documentation (EKS deployment procedures, Okta integration, GitHub usage guides) to improve knowledge sharing and onboarding efficiency
• Worked in a cloud-native AWS environment using Azure DevOps, GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: • Participated in the modernization of a legacy Classic ASP property management application by reverse engineering undocumented functionality and documenting business processes. Collaborated with Product to shape the user experience and application flow, and implemented full-stack features using Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL Server, and C#/.NET REST APIs, including unit tests

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a customer-facing recruitment and informational website for the U.S. Air National Guard using Agile Scrum, implementing responsive user interfaces with ASP.NET MVC, Razor Views, and JavaScript in collaboration with UX and Product 
• Enhanced a C#/.NET REST API for the U.S. Air National Guard that processed and transformed recruitment lead data, supporting integration with Salesforce CRM and Marketo through RabbitMQ-based pub/sub messaging in an event-driven architecture

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and supported the company's flagship web-based SaaS issue tracking and reporting platform used by major cruise lines, influencing user experience and workflow design, owning production deployments including on-site deployments aboard ships, and delivering customer-facing support and training
• Designed and delivered a Windows desktop passenger check-in application end-to-end, gathering requirements, defining user workflows, and performing on-site testing, onboarding, and user training
• Technologies: .NET Framework, Entity Framework, jQuery, WCF Services, SQL Server, Crystal Reports

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Worked as part of a development team building a logistics application for UPS Latin America using .NET and SQL Server

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Served as the primary software engineer developing and maintaining B2C e-commerce applications in the pharmaceutical industry
• Collaborated directly with company founders to assess business requirements and recommend technical solutions
